instruction: boltons.setutils.IndexedSet wraps out-of-range negative indexes around instead of raising IndexError once items have been removed: on a 9-item set x, x[-10] returns an item and x.pop(-15) silently removes a middle item. Indexing and pop must behave like a list: valid negative indexes work, and any index outside -len..len-1 raises IndexError (as does indexing an empty IndexedSet), including after removals that leave several gaps in the internal storage. Add tests.
